A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the CMB anisotropy spectrum is a powerful probe of the large-scale structure of our universe.
the CDM models with a high baryonic fraction are not ruled out by the COBE data, but that they are ruled out by the large-scale structure data.
the current limits on CMB anisotropics are consistent with the standard CDM model, but that a boost in power is not ruled out.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CMB is a very good probe for the nature of the dark matter and that the current data are consistent with a CDM model.
the angular scale of acoustic oscillations in the CMB is a direct probe of the expansion history of the Universe, and thus of the dark energy equation of state.
